title: Col de Turini and Roya Edges
slogan: A 98 km loop out of Sospel
story: Rally-road mythology with sea-level start. A 98 km loop that starts and ends near Sospel, about 1 h 53 of riding. The climb of the day is Col de Turini. It tops out at about 1,750 m. It is a high-mountain day. The plan has 1 food stop and 1 fuel stop marked.

title: Verdon Gorge Grand Day
slogan: A 210 km loop out of Grasse fuel
story: Big canyon drama, long day discipline. 210 km round from Grasse - plan on about 3 h 37 of riding. On the way it passes Castellane, Verdon balcony road and Lake Sainte-Croix. The highest point is about 1,450 m. The plan has 1 food stop and 1 fuel stop marked.

scenicChapters.title: Gorges du Verdon
scenicChapters.narrative: For 22 km this is Gorges du Verdon, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it — expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

scenicChapters.title: Gorges du Verdon
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 25 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go. Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.

storyWas: Big canyon drama, long day discipline.
